items.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The one record is the record with “Sister Sadie” on it—Blowin’ The Blues away.

ctx.x: What were some of the Horace Silver tunes that were kind of seminal for you?
The one record is the record with “Sister Sadie” on it—Blowin’ The Blues away.
Which is from 1959, if I’m not mistaken, so that would correlate to the last year...
